thread.title: Amazon stock surge could add over $50 billion to market cap, narrow Apple's lead to under $50 billion - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Amazon stock surge could add over $50 billion to market cap, narrow Apple's lead to under $50 billion - MarketWatch
text: Shares of Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, +3.96% were propelled 7.1% toward a record high in premarket trade Friday in the wake of blowout first-quarter results , putting them on track to add over $50 billion in market capitalization, and to narrow Apple Inc.'s AAPL, +0.35% lead as the biggest U.S. company by market cap to under $50 billion. The e-commerce and cloud services giant is headed for a market cap of about $788.5 billion, up from $736.2 billion at Thursday's close, while Apple Inc.'s AAPL, +0.35% 0.4% gain ahead of the open would put its market cap at $836.7 billion. The premarket price gain would also widen Co-Founder and CEO Jeff Bezos's lead as the world's richest person, by about $8.4 billion. Amazon's stock has run up 29.8% year to date through Thursday, while the Nasdaq 100 NDX, +2.08% has gained 4.0% and the S&P 500 SPX, +1.04% has slipped 0.3%.
